threshold.rule: Every county sales and use tax referendum provision in G.S. Chapter 105 in force 2008-2026 (Art. 46 quarter-cent, Art. 43 transportation, Art. 39 one-cent) uses the same test: the majority of those voting in the referendum must vote for the levy. The title does not say which Article a given question was held under, so the Art. 46 sentence (the one that fits the quarter-cent referendums of 2008-2026) is the main quote and the others are in also_cited. Inferred, not stated, for this reason.
threshold.quote: If the majority of those voting in a referendum held pursuant to this Article vote for the levy of the tax, the board of county commissioners may, by resolution and after 10 days' public notice, levy a local sales and use tax at a rate of one-quarter percent (0.25%).
threshold.matched: by the kind the source's words show (county local sales and use tax referendum (article not named in title)); every county sales and use tax article that puts the levy to the voters (39, 43, 46) sets this share; the title does not name the article
